items.claim: Shopify design guidance asks apps to align with established Shopify Admin visual and interaction patterns so merchants can use familiar conventions.
Polaris color guidance organizes color around roles and interaction meaning rather than treating palette swatches as decorative choices.
Polaris accessibility guidance requires color relationships to maintain usable contrast and not rely on color alone for meaning.
items.notes: Accessibility is part of operational trust.

items.claim: The strongest transferable quality is continuity with the user's working environment, not a standalone Shopify-looking skin.
